name: flutter-dependency-override-helper
description: Quick insert local or git dependency_overrides in pubspec

pubspecOverrides.packagesFolders.markdownDescription: Directories in which your local packages are located (absolute or relative to the workspace; `${workspaceFolder}` and `~` are supported).

pubspecOverrides.scanDepth.description: How many levels below the packages folders to search for pubspec.yaml.

pubspecOverrides.gitRepos.markdownDescription: Git repos for overrides. `name` is the package name, `url` is the Git URL, `path` is optional for packages in monorepos.

pubspecOverrides.defaultRef.description: Fallback for the Git reference if the current branch cannot be determined (e.g., detached HEAD).

pubspecOverrides.runPubGet.description: Automatically run 'dart pub get' or 'flutter pub get' after making changes.

pubspecOverrides.autoConfirmTypeConflict.description: Automatically confirm and bypass the warning when overriding a package with a different type (local <-> git).

pubspecOverrides.codeLens.enabled.description: Master switch for all CodeLens actions: the clickable links (Upgrade package, Add override, Remove package, Remove override, Switch to Local/Git) shown above the package names in pubspec.yaml. Use the settings below to hide single actions.

pubspecOverrides.codeLens.actions.upgrad.description: Show the "Upgrade package" CodeLens link above packages in dependencies/dev_dependencies (runs 'pub upgrade <package>').

pubspecOverrides.codeLens.actions.addOve.description: Show the "Add override" CodeLens link above packages that are available as local package or configured Git repo.

pubspecOverrides.codeLens.actions.remove.description: Show the "Remove package" CodeLens link above packages in dependencies/dev_dependencies.
Show the "Remove override" CodeLens link above entries in dependency_overrides.

pubspecOverrides.codeLens.actions.switch.description: Show the "Switch to Local" CodeLens link above overrides whose package is available locally.
Show the "Switch to Git" CodeLens link above overrides whose package is configured as Git repo.
